# Worker

## Purpose

Background jobs on BullMQ. Every queue is registered; only stubs process them.

## Features

- Redis connection and queue registration

- `apps/worker/src/billing/processor.ts`
- `apps/worker/src/billing/runtime.ts`

## Workspace dependencies

`@rcln/billing` · `@rcln/db` · `@rcln/db/unsafe` · `@rcln/payments`

## Known limitations

- No processors exist — queues accept jobs that nothing consumes
- No scheduled jobs, no dead-letter handling, no metrics rollup
